# Preview & Shorts Controls for YouTube v0.5.2

Full thumbnail previews, optional preview sound/volume, recommendation seeking with current/total time, and Shorts information auto-hide. Every new preview starts muted. Recommendation preview audio temporarily mutes the main video and restores its previous audio state on exit.

**Installable download:** `Preview-Shorts-Controls-0.5.2.zip`. Extract and load the folder containing `manifest.json` via Edge's **Load unpacked** option. The automatically generated source archive contains the repository; choose its `extension` subfolder instead.

Edge actual-use tested. Chrome/Whale unverified; Firefox/Safari require porting. GitHub manual installations require manual updates. No public store approval is implied.

모든 기능은 무료입니다. 후원은 선택 사항이며 [Lenged 개발 후원](https://buymeacoffee.com/lenged)에서 참여할 수 있습니다. [설치·사용 안내](https://github.com/orockandgto-glitch/shorts-in-place-preview#readme)를 확인하세요.
